'''Mag-shielding''' was a type of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion]] shielding that could be added to protect vulnerable electronic systems from damage.

==Characteristics==
Mag-shielding came in different grades, ranging from light to military, and was capable of protecting electronics from intense ion and electrical discharges. [[YVH-Series battle droid]] models utilized standard grade Mag-shielding to be resistant to the discharges of ion and electrical weaponry such as [[Gauss ball]]s, with at least some units having heavy enough shielding to be largely immune to them.
